title: Trail Series Super League: Kogelberg Biosphere Reserve
summary: A Trail Series Super League trail run through the Kogelberg Biosphere Reserve surrounding Kleinmond, with 23.5 km, 14 km and 7.3 km routes.
description: Experience some of the most spectacular routes in the TSSL, through the Kogelberg Biosphere Reserve surrounding Kleinmond. This is as diverse a route as you can get with coastal pathways, forests and mountain trails complete with spectacular ocean views.
profile: The Kogelberg leg of the Trail Series Super League is a trail run through the Kogelberg Biosphere Reserve around Kleinmond on Sunday 15 August 2027. Runners choose a 23.5 km, 14 km or 7.3 km route over coastal paths, forest and mountain trails with ocean views. Entries are not open yet; the short route suits newer trail runners and the long route more experienced ones.
